# Dialog

A modal dialog for a focused task that must be finished or cancelled before going back to the page, such as editing a track's cues and transitions.

`SongNodes.Dialog` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Dialog open onClose={…} title="…">…</SongNodes.Dialog>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Dialog" open="{{yes}}" on-close="{{…}}" title="…">…</x-import>
```

## Props (DialogProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state; uses the native <dialog> showModal() for the focus trap and Esc. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Called on Esc, the close button and Cancel. |
| `lead` | `string` | Regular lead of the thin–bold title: "Edit cues". |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold title: "Bicep – Glue". |
| `subtitle` | `string` | One-line context under the title: "Slot 7 of 18 in “Peak time Friday”". |
| `size` | `"s" \| "m" \| "l"` | S 400, M 600, L 800. M and L become full-screen sheets below 480px. |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Body content (scrolls). |
| `footer` * | `ReactNode` | Footer actions, right-aligned: Cancel then the primary. |
| `footerStart` | `ReactNode` | Optional quiet action at the left of the footer ("Reset cues"). |
| `initialFocusRef` | `{ current: HTMLElement \| null }` | Element to focus on open; default the first field, else the primary-adjacent Cancel. |
